meta.description: Markov chain of contra dance moves. first_order[move] gives the next-move distribution; second_order['a >> b'] gives the distribution of the move after a then b.
meta.beats: nodes[].beats: how long the move lasts. typical = most common, options = every length seen with how often (n), parts = component figures (balance 4 + swing 12). source: observed (measured from first_move_beat_offsets), inferred (from the span between neighbours), or default (contra convention, no data). first_order edges carry from_beats: the length of the source move when followed by that move. adjustable moves (seen at more than one length) can take any length in range; the viewer stretches them to the phrase end, or shrinks them so a fixed-length next move ends on the phrase end.
meta.in_data: nodes[].in_data is false for standard contra figures added so they can be sequenced by hand; they have no recorded transitions.
meta.phrases: The music is AABB: four 16-beat phrases A1, A2, B1, B2. nodes[].phrase_starts: which beat (1-16) of a phrase the move starts on, with how often. The source data gives position within a phrase but not which phrase, so A vs B is not recorded.
